name: feishu-connector
description: Sync Feishu/Lark data — a Bitable (多维表格), cloud docs (云文档), or a group/1:1 chat (聊天记录) — into a local SQLite DB via lark-cli, then register it as a Skardi data source so an AI agent can query it with SQL. Manual one-shot sync; docs stored as whole-doc markdown, chat as one row per message.
